text_block_list.text:
Yeah! As expected of a pro teacher. It was 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. The Paka Petit I won— would you 
like to have it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Since you won it for me, I want to make 
it friends with Kyumaru!"
